study type: Longitudinal cohort study (with comparison to national birth data)
cohort: The Growing Up in New Zealand longitudinal study recruited 6,846 children from before birth via their pregnant mothers residing in the greater Auckland and Waikato regions during 2009 and 2010.
finding: Birth parameters for the Growing Up in New Zealand cohort were generally closely aligned to all New Zealand births in 2007-2010, though the cohort had a lower proportion of low birth weight and preterm births and was expected to be more ethnically diverse.
followup_time: 6 weeks after expected delivery date (for initial data collection described in this abstract)
birth_weight: All babies born to recruited mothers were included; low birth weight (below 2500g) was a measured characteristic.
gest_age: All babies born to recruited mothers were included; preterm birth (less than 37 weeks gestation) was a measured characteristic.
